name: simpleticket
description: Connect a SimpleTicket organiser account to ChatGPT: query events, ticket sales, transactions, entrance scans, invoices and reports, and manage event webhooks.

interface.longDescription: Connect a SimpleTicket organiser account to ChatGPT. Ask questions about your events, ticket sales, transactions, entrance scans, invoices, mailings and reports — the same data the backoffice shows — and create, update or test event webhooks. Sign-in runs through OAuth on the SimpleTicket backoffice; the plugin only sees the merchant account that was authorized, at that user's access level (Owner or Admin required). Read tools cover every backoffice section; write access is limited to the merchant's own webhooks. The plugin cannot start payments, refunds or checkouts.
defaultPrompt: Which of my events are coming up and how are sales doing?
How many tickets were scanned at my last event?
List my open invoices and most recent transactions.

positive.prompt: Which of my events are coming up?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the merchant's upcoming events with names, dates and status.

positive.prompt: How many tickets have I sold for each event?
positive.expected_behavior: Per-event ticket counts split by product, category and derived status (sold, reserved, scanned, refunded).

positive.prompt: Show the details of my most recent transaction.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the latest transactions, then returns the chosen transaction's buyer, amounts, status and purchased tickets.

positive.prompt: Give me the sales summary for my event '<event name>'.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the named event and returns totals, revenue and sales figures for it.

positive.prompt: How many visitors were scanned at my last event?
positive.expected_behavior: Scan counts and no-show figures for the resolved event.

negative.description: Refunds are not possible through the plugin
negative.prompt: Refund my last transaction to the buyer.

negative.description: Destructive event deletion is not offered
negative.prompt: Delete my event and all tickets that were sold for it.
Show the ticket sales of a different organiser on SimpleTicket.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing in chat: it reports on the merchant's existing ticket sales and can only manage the merchant's own webhook configuration.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: SimpleTicket backoffice over MCP — OAuth 2.1 sign-in, merchant-scoped read tools (events, sales, transactions, scans, invoices, reports) and webhook management.

de-DE.subtitle: Dein Ticketverkauf-Backoffice
de-DE.description: Verbinde dein SimpleTicket-Organisatorkonto mit ChatGPT. Stelle Fragen zu deinen Veranstaltungen, Ticketverkäufen, Transaktionen, Einlass-Scans, Rechnungen und Berichten — denselben Daten wie im Backoffice — und verwalte die Webhooks deiner Veranstaltungen. Das Plugin sieht nur das Händlerkonto, das du per OAuth autorisierst.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu backoffice de entradas
es-ES.description: Conecta tu cuenta de organizador de SimpleTicket a ChatGPT. Haz preguntas sobre tus eventos, venta de entradas, transacciones, escaneos de entrada, facturas e informes — los mismos datos que en el backoffice — y gestiona los webhooks de tus eventos. El plugin solo ve la cuenta de comerciante autorizada mediante OAuth.

fr-FR.subtitle: Votre back-office billetterie
fr-FR.description: Connectez votre compte organisateur SimpleTicket à ChatGPT. Posez des questions sur vos événements, ventes de billets, transactions, scans d'entrée, factures et rapports — les mêmes données que dans le back-office — et gérez les webhooks de vos événements. Le plugin ne voit que le compte marchand autorisé via OAuth.

it-IT.subtitle: Backoffice vendita biglietti
it-IT.description: Collega il tuo account organizzatore SimpleTicket a ChatGPT. Fai domande su eventi, vendite di biglietti, transazioni, scansioni all'ingresso, fatture e report — gli stessi dati del backoffice — e gestisci i webhook dei tuoi eventi. Il plugin vede solo l'account merchant autorizzato tramite OAuth.

nl-NL.subtitle: Je ticketverkoop-backoffice
nl-NL.description: Koppel je SimpleTicket-organisatoraccount aan ChatGPT. Stel vragen over je evenementen, ticketverkoop, transacties, scans, facturen en rapportages — dezelfde gegevens als in de backoffice — en beheer de webhooks van je evenementen. De plugin ziet alleen het merchant-account dat je via OAuth autoriseert.

pl-PL.subtitle: Twój backoffice sprzedaży
pl-PL.description: Połącz swoje konto organizatora SimpleTicket z ChatGPT. Zadawaj pytania o swoje wydarzenia, sprzedaż biletów, transakcje, skany wejściowe, faktury i raporty — te same dane co w backoffice — i zarządzaj webhookami wydarzeń. Wtyczka widzi tylko konto merchanta autoryzowane przez OAuth.

pt-PT.subtitle: O seu backoffice de bilhetes
pt-PT.description: Ligue a sua conta de organizador SimpleTicket ao ChatGPT. Faça perguntas sobre os seus eventos, venda de bilhetes, transações, validações à entrada, faturas e relatórios — os mesmos dados do backoffice — e gira os webhooks dos seus eventos. O plugin vê apenas a conta de comerciante autorizada via OAuth.
